title: Holding Several Stays at Once (Guest Terms, Stays (Guest Reservations))
content:
# Holding several stays at once

**Clause.** Under the Stays (Guest Reservations) terms, a guest may hold any number of stays at the same time, on the same or different listings, including stays whose nights overlap on different listings. There is no cap on concurrent or lifetime stays. Two stays can never hold the same night on the same listing, because a confirmed or checked-in stay removes its nights from the listing's availability. Each stay is priced, paid, cancelled and refunded on its own; the only rule that reads across a guest's stays is the guest service fee refund cap.

| Question | Answer under this clause |
|---|---|
| Maximum number of stays one guest may hold | none — no cap on concurrent or lifetime stays |
| Overlapping nights on two different listings | allowed |
| The same night on the same listing in two stays | never possible: a confirmed or checked-in stay removes its nights from that listing's availability |
| Pricing, payment, cancellation and refund | each stay on its own |
| Rule that reads across the guest's stays | the guest service fee refund cap only |

## Basis Q&A

**A guest has three stays on file for the same weekend at three different listings. Is any of them limited by the others?**
No. Overlapping nights on different listings are allowed and there is no cap on how many stays a guest holds; each of the three is priced, paid, cancelled and refunded on its own.

**Can a second stay be booked for a night that a confirmed stay already holds at the same listing?**
No. While the first stay is confirmed or checked in, that night is not in the listing's availability.

**Does cancelling one stay change how another stay of the same guest is refunded?**
Only through the guest service fee refund cap, which is the one rule that reads across a guest's stays.
